I'm applying for the 2027 Mechanical Engineer Intern role at Anduril. Two things about your preferred qualifications jumped out immediately: electromechanical integration of motors, sensors, and controllers, and an interest in engineers who come from first-principles, build-it-yourself backgrounds. I also rebuilt a two-stroke motorcycle engine by hand over several years, which is where my first-principles instincts actually started. I model in SolidWorks and OnShape and I'm comfortable with machining and 3D printing for rapid hardware iteration.

I'd welcome the opportunity to bring that combination — real electromechanical build experience and real threat-assessment research — to Anduril this summer.

Sincerely,
Jasmeh Singh Bhurjee
